nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
## MiniMax H3

[MiniMax H3](https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-h3) is MiniMax's general-purpose, omni-modal generation model. It jointly understands text, image, video, and audio, and generates video with **native stereo audio**: voice, sound effects, and music are modeled jointly in a single forward pass, not layered on afterward. Output is up to 2K resolution, 24fps, and up to about 15 seconds.

## ComfyUI links
- [ComfyUI#15224](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI/pull/15224)
- [🤗 Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3](https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3)

## About this workflow

This template runs the **reference-to-video (ref2va)** task using the `MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo` node. It takes any mix of reference images, videos, and standalone audio, and weaves them into the generation to lock in a character's identity, a style, a motion, a camera move, or a voice.

**Key inputs**

- **ref_images / ref_videos / ref_video_audios / ref_audios**: up to 9 reference images, 3 reference videos (each may carry its own paired soundtrack), and 3 standalone reference audio clips
- **prompt**: reference the inputs by tag, in the exact order they were connected, for example `<Picture 1>`, `<Video 1>`, `<Audio 1>`, then describe the target scene, motion, and audio
- **ref_image_size**: `match` scales references down to the generation's resolution (faster); `max` keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, at the cost of speed since reference tokens ride along every sampling step
- **width / height**: set via Resolution Selector.
- **duration (seconds)**: converted to a valid frame `length` by the Math Expression node

**Sampling and decode**

- Sampler: `res_multistep`. `beta` or `normal` scheduler tends to outperform `simple` for reference-heavy prompts like this one
- The sampler's joint audio+video `LATENT` output feeds directly into both `VAEDecode` (video, `minimax_h3_video_vae_fp16`) and `VAEDecodeAudio` (audio, `minimax_h3_audio_vae_fp32`); each decode node automatically pulls its own half out of the packed latent. `CreateVideo` then muxes the two into a single MP4 with synced sound
- The diffusion model here is `minimax_h3_ref2va_pruned_int8_convrot.safetensors`, a different set of weights from the `fl2va` model used by the t2v/i2v templates

Ref2va's output is very sensitive to prompt wording; matching the reference tags precisely and being explicit about which reference drives which part of the shot tends to work best.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the rider with her motorcycle; it also gives the flooded alley location and its look.
@image2  is the landscape
@audio1  is the character voice

summary:
[reference generation] @image1 sits on her idling motorcycle in the flooded alley, speaks, then races toward the camera.

detailed_description:
Gritty cyberpunk action film, desaturated teal haze with rust-orange accents, handheld energy. The layout matches @image1: a narrow alley of rusted shopfronts, hanging cables and pipes, puddles over cracked wet asphalt, the bike facing the camera in the middle of the street. Exactly one person in frame throughout; no on-screen text, subtitles or watermarks.

[Shot 1] Medium close-up at handlebar height, the camera Pushes in toward @image1 with small amplitude at slow speed. The engine idles under her, the whole bike trembling, exhaust vapour curling up from the pipes, light drizzle falling through the haze. Her gloved right hand twists the throttle twice and the bike growls. She lifts her chin toward the lens and the line begins right away. @image1 (S1), low, dry and confident, says in English: "Tell them they're late. I'm already gone." Her lips close immediately after the final word and stay closed for the rest of the video; she does not speak again. She drops her head and leans forward over the tank.

[Shot 2] At 00:05.000, hard cut to a low wide tracking shot just above the puddles, use @image2 as element for the scene, the camera Tracks backward ahead of her with large amplitude at fast speed. @image1 launches down the alley straight toward the lens, the rear tyre spinning then gripping, the fat front wheel slicing through the puddles and throwing sheets of muddy water to both sides. Her hair whips back, her body stays low over the tank, her mouth stays closed in a tight line. The acceleration is one continuous run that takes up the whole rest of the video, never slowing and never stopping. Shop lights and hanging cables streak past on both sides, spray hangs in the air behind her, and she stays centred in frame, growing larger as she gains on the camera until the front wheel fills the frame at the end. 

overall_soundscape: Light rain patter and dripping pipes across the alley, a deep idling engine from the first frame, two sharp throttle revs before the line. On the cut the engine bursts into a full roar with tyre hiss on wet asphalt and heavy water splashes echoing off the walls, the roar building through the final seconds as she closes on the camera. She makes only short breaths through the nose; no other voices.

non_diegetic_music: Dark synth bass at about 100 BPM, a pulsing sub-bass drone under the first shot, then a heavy gated snare and distorted bass hit landing exactly on the cut and driving to the end.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the man in the tuxedo.
@image2 is the location: a vast turbine hall with a giant fan, steel scaffolding, thick pipes and a wet concrete floor.
@image3 is the stone-armoured golem with glowing orange seams.

summary:
[reference generation] @image1 fights @image3 in the central aisle of the turbine hall of @image2.

detailed_description:
prfight2, prfin1. Gritty blockbuster fight film, dark industrial grade with a cold shaft of light from above, handheld camera, hard physical impacts. The layout is the same in every shot: @image1 and @image3 face each other in the central aisle of @image2, the giant fan turning slowly behind them, pipes and railings along both sides. @image3 stands twice the height of @image1, heavy and slow; @image1 is fast and precise. Exactly two figures in frame throughout; no on-screen text.

[Shot 1] Low wide shot, the camera Tracks forward toward them with small amplitude at slow speed. @image3 charges and throws a huge right hook at head height; @image1 ducks under it and the stone fist smashes into a pipe behind him, which bursts in a jet of white steam.@image1 rises inside its reach, squarely facing @image3, and drives a fast one-two into the glowing chest core; each punch lands with a dull crack, stone chips and orange sparks spray off, and @image3's torso rocks back one heavy step.

[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, cut to a side tracking shot, both seen in profile, the camera Trucks sideways with them. @image3 answers with a sweeping backhand that catches @image1 in the ribs, lifts him off his feet and throws him sideways into a steel railing, which bends under his back. He drops to one knee, one hand on the wet floor, his jacket torn at the shoulder. @image3 stamps forward after him, each step cracking the concrete.

[Shot 3] At 00:08.000, cut to a low angle medium shot, the camera Arcs around them with small amplitude at fast speed. @image3 brings a two-handed hammer fist straight down; @image1 rolls aside and the fists crater the floor, water and concrete chunks bursting up. @image1 springs onto its forearm and drives a spinning elbow, then a jumping knee, into its helmet; the faceplate cracks, its eyes flicker, and @image3 topples backward and crashes flat on the wet floor in a wave of spray. @image1 lands in a crouch and stays there, chest heaving.

Throughout the whole video @image1's mouth stays a tight grim line and he never speaks; @image3 has no mouth and makes no vocal sound.

overall_soundscape: A deep hum from the giant fan and dripping water run under the whole video, with steam hissing from the burst pipe. Heavy stone cracks and dull thuds land on every punch, metal screeches as the railing bends, concrete splits under each stamp, and the final fall crashes with a burst of spray. The golem's joints grind and groan, and the man makes only sharp breaths and short effort grunts through his nose, no words anywhere. In the last seconds debris rattles down and the steam slowly hisses out under his heavy breathing.

non_diegetic_music: Pounding low taiko drums and distorted synth bass at a driving tempo, accents hitting on the big impacts, a sharp stop on the final crash, then one low sustained drone to the end.

subject_definitions:
@image1 is the man in the tuxedo.
@image2 is the tattooed man in the grey top and cargo pants.
@image3 is the location: a ruined, flooded city street lined with wrecked rusted cars.

summary:
[reference generation] @image1 fights @image2 beside a wrecked sedan on the ruined street of @image3.

detailed_description:
prfight2, prfin1. Gritty practical action film, real-time speed with no slow motion, handheld camera close to the fighters, hard cuts landing on the impacts, desaturated daylight with cool cyan shadows. The layout is the same in every shot: @image1 and @image2 stand face to face in the middle of the ruined street of @image3, a wrecked rusted sedan right beside them, the wide puddle at their feet, collapsed buildings and hanging cables beyond. Exactly two people in frame throughout; no on-screen text.

[Shot 1] Tight handheld two-shot. @image2 steps into @image1's face and jabs a finger into his chest. @image2 (S1), low and threatening, says in English: "Wrong street, pretty boy." His lips close right after the last word. @image1 stands completely still, lips pressed closed, and stares back.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, hard cut to a medium shot. Without warning @image1 snaps a short right elbow into @image2's jaw; his head whips sideways and he staggers back against the sedan. He comes off it swinging a wild overhand right; @image1 parries it with his left forearm, traps the arm and drives a short hook and an uppercut into his ribs and chin.

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000, hard cut to a low angle wide shot. @image1 fires a snapping front kick into @image2's chest that sends him stumbling backward into the puddle, water spraying up to his knees. @image2 lunges back in; @image1 catches him by the back of the neck and drags him two steps to the sedan's driver door.

[Shot 4] At 00:09.000, hard cut to a tight handheld shot at the driver door. @image1 slams @image2's head into the side window and the glass shatters into a spray of pieces. He hauls him back and throws him over his hip; @image2 lands flat on his back in the wet rubble and stays there, motionless. @image1 straightens his jacket and stands over him, breathing hard.

Throughout the whole video @image1 never speaks and keeps his lips closed; after his one line @image2 makes only grunts and sharp breaths, no words.

overall_soundscape: Wind moving through the ruins, loose cables creaking and water dripping run under the whole video. Every body hit lands as a deep bass thud, the sedan's panels boom and rattle when he is thrown against it, the puddle splashes hard, and the side window bursts with a crunch of safety glass tinkling onto the ground. The only voices are the single line and the men's sharp breaths and short grunts, no other words. In the last seconds glass pieces settle on the rubble under heavy breathing and the wind.

non_diegetic_music: N/A
